# SPE Round 5 plan: invoice extraction

Round 5 tests one fix for F9. Config S is R, except that S skips OCR cleanup on two-column invoices. Q and R run unchanged as controls. P is retired. The handwritten-invoice proposal (P2) waits for reference fields from the AP lead.

Defaults I chose because the paste did not show them:
- The spec.md and disagreements.md tables were not pasted. I assume round 4 ended at R29 and D7, so new rows start at R30 and D8. If the files show other numbers, I will use the next free IDs and note the change in the transcript.
- I read the prediction-log columns as metric, config, predicted, measured, naive, hit or miss, and closer guess.
- I assume about 15 of the 60 invoices use a two-column layout. The layout tags will give the real count. The slice bands below are wide because of this assumption.
- I assume each config runs 1 trial per invoice, as in r04.

Loop status: the stop streak is 0 of 3, because R missed in r04. No config is at a ceiling. Q measured 0.93 and R measured 0.88.

## 1. Specify

### Round 4 proposals

| Proposal | Decision | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| P1 Keep OCR cleanup but skip it on two-column layouts | Adopt as a new config S. R stays unchanged. | S differs from R in one thing, so a difference can be traced to the skip. R stays as the control that reproduces F9. |
| P2 Add 15 scanned invoices with handwriting | Reject for r05 and log as D8 | (1) Q at 0.93 is not a ceiling. A ceiling means every config hits the maximum, and R is at 0.88. (2) The 15 invoices need reference fields from the AP lead, and none exist yet. Claude will not write reference fields. (3) Changing the eval set and a config in the same round would hide which change caused a difference. |
| P3 Drop config P | Adopt | P trails Q on every r04 metric. Q is P plus the schema-first prompt, so Q is the baseline now. Dropping P frees the 60 runs that S uses. P's r04 rows stay in the log. |

### Requirement table, round 5 (added to spe/spec/spec.md)

| ID | Requirement | Source | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| R30 | Config S calls the OCR cleanup tool on single-column invoices and does not call it on two-column invoices. | r04 F9, P1 adopted | Grader check `cleanup_calls_by_layout`: S has 0 cleanup calls on invoices tagged two_col and at least 1 on scanned invoices tagged one_col. |
| R31 | S decides the layout with its own detector. The detector agrees with the hand tags on at least 57 of 60 invoices. The detector never reads the tag file. | r04 F9 (P1 needs a layout signal) | Grader check `layout_agreement` is 0.95 or higher. The dry-run leak check finds no tag-file path in S's inputs. |
| R32 | On the two-column slice, S's field accuracy is no more than 0.02 below Q's. | r04 F9 | Grader check `field_accuracy[layout=two_col]`, S compared with Q. |
| R33 | The grader reports field accuracy for all 60 invoices and for each layout slice. A separate tagger writes the layout tags before any r05 trial. The tagger sees only the PDFs and never sees agent output or agent code. | Decision that the author does not touch the judge, r04 F9 | Grader selftest `slice_sum`: the slice counts add up to 60. The tag file is committed before the Workflow launches. |
| R34 | Config P is retired. Any row that tests only P gets the note "retired r05 (P3)". | P3 adopted | The Workflow arguments list only Q, R, and S. |
| R35 | The eval set stays the same 60 invoices with the AP lead's reference fields. | P2 rejected for r05, comparability with r04 | Grader selftest `manifest_hash` matches the r04 manifest hash. |

### New row in spe/spec/disagreements.md

| ID | Question | Option A | Option B | Work affected | Decides | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| D8 | Should we add 15 handwritten scanned invoices? | Ask the AP lead for the invoices and their reference fields, then score them as a separate slice in r06. | Leave the eval set at 60 invoices. | Eval set, R35, r06 predictions | User, with the AP lead | Open. The r05 default is B because the reference fields do not exist. |

## 2. Predict

Q and R did not change, so they keep their r04 measured values. Only S gets new numbers. The naive guess for each row is the r04 result: the logged value for the overall row, and the control regrade of r04 outputs for the slice rows. A cell is a hit when the measured value falls inside its band.

| Metric | Q | R | S | Grader check | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Field accuracy, all 60 | 0.93 ± 0.03 | 0.88 ± 0.03 | 0.94 ± 0.03 | `field_accuracy` | Q and R are unchanged. S uses R's cleanup on single-column invoices and Q's path on two-column invoices, so S should match or beat both. |
| Field accuracy, two-column slice | 0.93 ± 0.05 | 0.70 ± 0.10 | 0.92 ± 0.05 | `field_accuracy[layout=two_col]` | F9 says cleanup drops line items on two-column layouts. S skips cleanup there, so S should land near Q. |
| Field accuracy, single-column slice | 0.93 ± 0.03 | 0.94 ± 0.03 | 0.94 ± 0.03 | `field_accuracy[layout=one_col]` | R's r04 Why ("OCR cleanup fixes scanned totals") may still hold on single-column pages. S runs the same cleanup there, so S should match R. |

S has no r04 run, so R's r04 value of 0.88 is S's naive guess on the overall row.

## 3. Evaluate

### After approval, before any trial

1. Save the prompt and the pasted text word for word in `spe/spec/transcripts/2026-10-21-r05.md`.
2. Add the r05 requirement table to `spe/spec/spec.md`. Mark the retired P rows. Add D8 to `spe/spec/disagreements.md`. Commit locally with the subject `spe(r05): spec`.
3. Copy this plan to `spe/plans/r05.md`. Write `spe/predictions/r05.yaml` from the Predict table. Commit locally with the subject `spe(r05): plan and prediction`. I will not edit the yaml after this commit.

### Gates, in order. Each gate must pass before the next one runs.

| Step | What runs | Pass condition | On fail |
|---|---|---|---|
| G1 Layout tags | A separate subagent reads the 60 PDFs and writes `spe/evals/layout-tags-r05.csv` with one_col or two_col for each invoice. It sees no agent code or output. Commit the file before G2. | Every invoice has 1 tag. | Halt and report. |
| G2 Grader selftest | Grade the reference fields against themselves. Grade a copy with known errors added. Run `slice_sum` and `manifest_hash`. | Reference fields score 1.00. The copy with errors scores its expected value. The slices add up to 60. The manifest hash matches r04. | Halt. The grader is broken. |
| G3 Control regrade | Regrade the stored r04 outputs for Q and R with the r05 grader. | Q reproduces 0.93 and R reproduces 0.88, each within 0.005. Record the slice values as the naive guesses for the slice rows. | Halt. The grader changed. |
| G4 Dry run | S runs on 3 invoices: 2 two_col and 1 scanned one_col. The results are not scored. | The traces show no cleanup call on the two_col invoices and a cleanup call on the one_col invoice. A leak check finds no reference-field path or tag-file path in any agent input. | Halt on a leak. Fix S and repeat G4 on any other failure. |
| G5 Launch | Run the Workflow below. | The run finishes under the budget cap. | Halt and report at the cap. |

### Workflow arguments (`spe/evals/harness/r05-workflow.js`)

```
round: 5
configs: [Q, R, S]
model: Sonnet 5.5
evalSet: 60 invoices, r04 manifest
trialsPerInvoice: 1
layoutTags: spe/evals/layout-tags-r05.csv   (grader only, never passed to agents)
predictions: spe/predictions/r05.yaml
outDir: spe/evals/results/r05/
budgetCap: 1.5 x r04 recorded spend
```

### Cost estimate (not measured)

- 180 agent runs, which matches r04 because S replaces P.
- 60 PDF reads by the tagger.
- 3 dry-run invoices.
- At about 25k input and 2k output tokens per run, the agent runs total about 4.9M tokens. This number is an estimate. I have not measured it.

### After the run

1. Commit the harness script and results with the subject `spe(r05): eval results`.
2. Learn step: add the r05 rows to `spe/prediction-log.md`, with hit or miss and the closer guess for each row. If any row misses, name which Why broke. Mark F9 fixed only if R30 and R32 pass. Log any new failure type as F10 or later. Leave a "Proposed for round 6" table and draft predictions, and carry D8 forward. Commit with the subject `spe(r05): learn`.

All commits stay local. I will not push, and the commit messages will not mention Claude.
